summary: Verified MyBusinessesPage empty-state (emptyuser) shows compact glowing 'Open business' button with placeholder panels, and regression for testuser (Bio Farm) and admin (Signal Tower) remains correct.
critical_code_review_comments: For business accounts, action buttons visible in DOM but do not carry the data-testids listed in the spec (repair-btn/start-shift-btn/upgrade-btn). If E2E automation relies on those testids, they should be added. Currently only visual verification via screenshot succeeded.

For business (non-empty) accounts, the panel elements do not carry data-testid attributes analogous to the -empty variants (e.g., durability-value, storage-panel, income-chip, expense-chip). Adding these would improve testability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Empty-state verified: acquire-business-btn (Open business, 190px wide) inside .biz-open-glow wrapper, navigates to /maps. Panels: durability-value-empty=0.0%, storage-panel-empty='Warehouse: — / —', income-chip-empty=0, expense-chip-empty=0. No action buttons for empty user. Business accounts show normal art/title/status/panels/action buttons and no vertical scroll (390x800 -> sh=ch=800). Business-account testids for action buttons and non-empty panels are not present; consider adding.
